description: Small labelled evaluation set for the live kernel (Rev 3 section 16): answerable control, unanswerable, missing-information, contradictory and out-of-scope decision requests. `expected` lists the acceptable outcome classes; a decision request that cannot be answered must never end as `completed`.

outcome_classes.completed: status completed with a decision output
outcome_classes.waiting_host: paused for bounded host work (options, criteria, research, synthesis)
outcome_classes.waiting_human: paused with a question for the human
outcome_classes.not_decided: partial, blocked, failed or cancelled: no decision was produced
